parameters.help_en: The name of a real-time log delivery project
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The domain names from which logs were collected. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The region to which real-time logs are delivered
parameters.name: sls_region

parameters.help_en: The name of the Log Service project
parameters.name: sls_project

parameters.help_en: The name of the Log Service Logstore
parameters.name: sls_log_store

parameters.help_en:
The data center. Valid values:

cn: China

sg: Singapore

eu: Europe

us: United States
parameters.help_zh:
数据中心。取值：

cn：中国
sg：新加坡
eu：欧洲
us：美国
parameters.name: data_center

parameters.help_en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn_log_access_l1. Valid values:

cdn_log_access_l1: access logs of Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

cdn_log_origin: back-to-origin logs

cdn_log_er: EdgeRoutine logs
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，取值：

cdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：用户访问日志。
cdn_log_er：边缘程序日志。
